# Fixture Provenance

These photos are **test fixtures**, not user data. They are real, openly
licensed photographs committed so the Phase 1 pipelines are verified against
reality — never against synthetic stand-ins dressed up as results.

AGENTS.md rule 7 forbids committing raw user images. That ban stands: user
captures exist only in request memory and are never written to disk
(BUILD_PLAN §5). The `.gitignore` exception covers this directory only.

Machine-readable copy: `provenance.json`.
